plan: tasks/todo.md, P5 'The run that moves nobody', task 47

design.question: Which off-ball run subtypes displace the defence, measured on the tracking in the window after the run starts, against a placebo of the same runner at another instant of a possession of his team.

outcome.is: displacement of the defence in the tracking (decision 1)
never: EPV (absent from the runs; the possession that carries it is shared)
any other provider label or measure
outcome.provider_measures_are_for: contrasting the instrument only: last_defensive_line_height_start in task 49

split.rule: inside each group of event_coords_exact, by kickoff_utc then match_id, alternating and starting with calibration (decision 3, split A)

cause.instant: t_c = frame_start of the off_ball_run event, the provider's frame, which is frame_native of silver frames
cause.rule: every cause is measured at t_c or before it; the effect, after it, as the residual of what the defence's velocity at t_c already predicted

windows.effect_window_rule: 2.0 s is a hypothesis until task 49 measures the cadence of the football tracking; 49 may replace it only by the minimum window that cadence admits, once, before any per-subtype effect, and writes the change in history

frames.coordinates: silver frames_attacking (x_att_m, y_att_m): the runner's team attacks towards +x, the frame of the provider's events
frames.runner: entity fb:<player_id> of dim_entity, the player_id of the event
frames.opponents: entities of kind player of the other team of the match
frames.detection: is_detected per frame; extrapolated positions are used as the provider gives them and flagged, and task 50 (M4) repeats every effect with the marker detected in the whole window

instrument.run_direction: d = unit vector from the runner's tracked position at frame_start to his position at frame_end; runs shorter than 1.0 m are excluded
instrument.marker: the opponent nearest to the runner at t_c, goalkeeper included
instrument.marker_displacement_m: projection on d of [p(t_c + W) - p(t_c)] - v(t_c) * W, with v(t_c) = [p(t_c) - p(t_c - V)] / V, W the effect window and V the velocity window; positive means the marker moved with the run
instrument.line_height_m: L(t) = mean x_att of the two deepest outfield opponents (largest x_att, goalkeepers excluded); residual [L(t_c + W) - L(t_c)] - v_L(t_c) * W with v_L(t_c) = [L(t_c) - L(t_c - V)] / V; positive means the line dropped towards its own goal
instrument.forced_direction_check: task 49, every run together: the marker displacement beats the placebo in the run's direction, per match and pooled, against the bar; the line height against the provider's last_defensive_line_height_start, correlation and median difference per match
instrument.standardisation: each quantity divided by the sd of its placebo values pooled over the calibration half, fixed in task 49 and never recomputed

placebo.candidate: a player_possession of a teammate (never the runner), in another team phase (phase_index), with the run's team_in_possession_phase_type
placebo.instant: t' = candidate.frame_start + (run.frame_start - run.associated_player_possession_frame_start), inside the candidate's phase window of phases_of_play so the team still has the ball
placebo.exclusion: no run of the runner's team overlapping [t' - 3 s, t' + 3 s], teammates included
placebo.choice: among the admissible candidates, the instant nearest in time to t_c; ties go to the earlier one
placebo.direction: the placebo inherits d of its run, in the attack frame of the team
placebo.windows: the same W and V around t' as around t_c

teammates_runs.alternative: exclude the runner's own runs only
teammates_runs.why: the placebo stands for the defence with nobody running; a teammate's run inside its window would put a run in the placebo (a trap the review list names); the price is the coverage in evidence.placebo_counts_calibration, team_overlap against runner_overlap

effect.pair: quantity(run) - quantity(placebo), one pair per run
effect.per_match: mean of the pairs of the subtype in the match: one row per match, ten per half, always before any aggregate
effect.pooled: mean of every pair of the subtype in the half, matches weighted by their pairs
effect.unit_of_independence: the possession: pairs sharing associated_player_possession_event_id move together in the null
effect.pre_trend: the same statistic with t_c replaced by t_c - W, which must stay flat (task 50, M3)
effect.grouping: by provider subtype, and again by a class computed only with information up to t_c (task 50): the label groups, it does not cause
effect.analysis_set: clean runs (task 48: complete window, runner detected throughout) with an admissible placebo and a direction of at least the minimum length

null.kind: permutation inside each match, never across matches
null.how: sign flip of the paired differences per possession cluster inside each match; to compare subtypes, subtype labels shuffled inside each match
null.p_value: two-sided, (1 + count of |stat*| >= |stat|) / (1 + n_permutations), on the pooled statistic

testability.in: both halves, with the real null and the design effect measured in task 49; a subtype that fails is said untestable with this sample, never noise

held_out.multiplicity: Holm over the candidates frozen in task 50

bar.hardening: if the real null fires 'at least one subtype' above 5.0 %, the bar hardens once, in task 49, with the figure written in history; it never loosens (D13)

death_criteria.M1: task 49: fewer than 2 probable subtypes (testability) -> P5 dies: the sample does not pay for the question
death_criteria.M2: task 49: the instrument does not pass the bar in calibration -> P5 dies: the instrument does not see even what is forced, and the null of a deaf instrument says nothing about the runs
death_criteria.M3: task 50: the pre-trend reaches 50 % of the effect, or the class at t_c gives the opposite sign to the subtype -> that subtype leaves (reaction or circularity)
death_criteria.M4: task 50: with the marker detected in the whole window the effect changes sign or falls below half -> that subtype leaves (extrapolation)
death_criteria.M5a: task 50: zero candidates -> P5 dies, the held-out half is never opened, and the page says so
death_criteria.M5b: task 51: no candidate replicates in the held-out half -> the negative is published, with the two halves side by side
death_criteria.if_dead: published dead, same route and title, with the probe's per-match figures, the funnel, the power, the null, the protocol with the sha of every stage and what was never opened (decision 7)

scope.page_says: how many metres the defence moved against the placebo, never that a player drags or fools anyone

placebo_counts_calibration.what: runs of the calibration half with at least one admissible placebo under each rule, from dynamic_events and phases_of_play only; a coverage count, never an outcome; task 48 bounds it with the tracking
